_doc: The starter sound library that audio/score.py looks for in ~/.video-forge/sounds/ (NAME.wav, 48 kHz). The audio is NOT in this repository: generated and licensed sounds stay on your machine (most generators' terms forbid redistributing the files as a library). These are the prompts and lengths that built it with ElevenLabs Sound Effects v2 (prompt_influence 0.5) and ElevenLabs Music v2.5; 18 effects cost 169 credits and the 62 s track 930 credits in November 2026. Any recording or licensed pack works: save it under the same name. Without a file, score.py falls back to the synthesized stand-in named in `synth` (null = the cue is skipped).

sounds.name: snip
sounds.prompt: One crisp snip of heavy metal shears cutting a thin piece of metal, close and dry, no reverb

sounds.name: coin
sounds.prompt: A single silver coin dropped on a wooden counter, bright metallic ring, short, close and dry

sounds.name: coins
sounds.prompt: A sack of silver coins poured out, cascading metallic clinking, close and dry

sounds.name: hammer
sounds.prompt: A single hammer blow on a small anvil, sharp metallic clang, dry workshop, no echo

sounds.name: rasp
sounds.prompt: A metal file rasping the edge of a coin, three short scraping strokes, close and dry

sounds.name: hooves
sounds.prompt: A horse-drawn carriage arriving on wet cobblestones, trotting hooves and rattling wheels slowing to a stop

sounds.name: thunder
sounds.prompt: Distant rolling thunder, one roll, no rain

sounds.name: rain_loop
sounds.prompt: Steady rain falling on a cobbled street at night, no thunder, no voices, no music

sounds.name: sizzle
sounds.prompt: Metal coins dropping into molten metal in a hot crucible, sizzling hiss and steam

sounds.name: press
sounds.prompt: A heavy iron screw press stamping once: a deep mechanical thunk followed by a small metallic clink

sounds.name: car
sounds.prompt: A small car pulling up and stopping at the curb, light brake squeak, engine idling

sounds.name: crowd_cheer
sounds.prompt: A small street crowd of about eight people cheering and laughing briefly, lively, outdoors

sounds.name: crowd_gasp
sounds.prompt: A small crowd gasping in surprise all at once, short

sounds.name: crowd_clap
sounds.prompt: A small group of people applauding briefly, outdoors

sounds.name: crowd_laugh
sounds.prompt: A small group of people laughing briefly, warm, indoors

sounds.name: whoosh
sounds.prompt: A fast cartoon whoosh, air swish passing by, short, dry

sounds.name: impact
sounds.prompt: A punchy low thud impact hit, cartoon, short, dry

sounds.name: street_day
sounds.prompt: Quiet old market street ambience, distant chatter and footsteps, a few birds, no music

music.name: music_sneaky
music.prompt: Playful, sneaky orchestral underscore for a cartoon history short about a heist: pizzicato strings, bassoon, clarinet, light percussion and a soft harpsichord, mischievous and steadily building, around 104 bpm, a calmer middle section, then a bright confident ending with a final button hit. Instrumental only, no vocals.

licence_note: Check the terms of whatever produced a file before you publish with it. Generated effects and music are tied to the generating account's plan; recorded or bought sounds to their own licence. Keep a line per file in ~/.video-forge/sounds/LICENCES.md.
